name: TC-AN-QB-004 — 批量填写：部分不合法（剔除+提示）[P0]
description: 审核节点编辑页已打开
module: 审核管理/审核节点管理/参与人快捷按钮

steps.expression: (() => { const rows = document.querySelectorAll('.ant-table-row'); if (rows.length > 0) { const editBtn = rows[0].querySelector('a[href*=edit], button'); if (editBtn) { editBtn.click(); return { clicked: true }; } } return { clicked: false }; })()

(() => { const btns = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('button')); const batchBtn = btns.find(b => (b.textContent || '').includes('批量填写')); if (!batchBtn) return { clicked: false, error: '未找到按钮' }; batchBtn.click(); return { clicked: true }; })()

(() => { const modal = document.querySelector('.ant-modal, .ant-drawer'); if (!modal) return { found: false }; const textarea = modal.querySelector('textarea, .ant-input'); const mixedJson = JSON.stringify([{empId:'421225',empName:'宗育'},{empId:'999999',empName:'不存在的人'},{empId:'000000',empName:'错误姓名'}]); const setter = Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(window.HTMLTextAreaElement.prototype, 'value').set; setter.call(textarea, mixedJson); textarea.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', { bubbles: true })); textarea.dispatchEvent(new Event('change', { bubbles: true })); return { found: true, inputted: mixedJson }; })()
steps.description: 粘贴混合合法+不合法的JSON

steps.expression: (() => { const modal = document.querySelector('.ant-modal, .ant-drawer'); const confirmBtn = Array.from(modal.querySelectorAll('button')).find(b => (b.textContent || '').includes('确认导入') || (b.textContent || '').includes('确认')); if (confirmBtn) { confirmBtn.click(); return { clicked: true }; } return { clicked: false }; })()

(() => { const toasts = document.querySelectorAll('.ant-message-notice, .ant-notification-notice'); const toastTexts = Array.from(toasts).map(t => t.textContent.trim()); const hasPartialResult = toastTexts.some(t => t.includes('总计') && t.includes('剔除')); return { toasts: toastTexts, hasPartialResult }; })()

_testDesign.preconditions: 审核节点编辑页已打开
_testDesign.stepsText: 1. 点击「批量填写」\n2. 粘贴混合JSON: 1条合法 + 2条不合法(工号不存在/姓名不一致)\n3. 点击确认导入
_testDesign.expectedResult: 1. 弹窗关闭\n2. 合法项写入表单，不合法项被剔除\n3. toast:「总计 3 条，成功 1 条（新增 X 位），剔除 2 条：id 999999 name 不存在的人（工号不在系统）; ...」
_testDesign.groupPath: 审核管理/审核节点管理/参与人快捷按钮
